stimulus.question: Checkout is reported to show elevated errors in the OTel Demo. report_parsed.summary: In the last 5 minutes (2026-11-03T19:57:25Z–20:02:25Z) checkout does show a failure and a large latency elevation, and it traces to its gRPC call to cart's EmptyCart, where the cart-side server span is the slow, erroring one. Evidence: checkout's span metrics contain STATUS_CODE_ERROR on span oteldemo.CartService/EmptyCart (the only checkout error series carrying a non-zero increase), and checkout's average span duration for oteldemo.CartService/EmptyCart is 16,994 ms and for oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder 17,055 ms, versus 5.33 ms and 24.23 ms in the 19:32:25–19:37:25 baseline. On the dependency side, cart's own span POST /oteldemo.CartService/EmptyCart has the same 1.25 ERROR increase, all of its finite duration buckets are 0 and only +Inf holds the value, i.e. the erroring span is >15,000 ms; a second, non-error EmptyCart span finished in ≤10 ms. The same bucket split appears on checkout's client span for that call. Cart's instrumented children stay fast throughout the hour (HGET ≈0.41 ms, HMSET ≈0.36 ms, EXPIRE ≈0.23 ms, GetCart ≈0.74 ms, AddItem ≈1.67 ms, flagd ResolveBoolean ≈4.5 ms), so no dependency of cart explains the stall; an earlier 17:02–17:07 baseline shows cart EmptyCart at 6.71 ms with zero ERROR spans, and 19:07–19:50 shows 1.5–26 ms, confirming this is new behaviour whose onset is ~19:47–19:51Z and again inside the last 5 minutes. Payment, product-catalog, currency, shipping and email show no error increase and no material latency change versus baseline. Two separate things also appear and are not this cause: a payment Charge error burst that ran until ~19:47Z and is now zero, and steady frontend-proxy ingress / load-generator POST errors present all hour. The final cause of the >15 s cart EmptyCart stall is not resolvable with the available sources, and trace ids could not be obtained because traces_search failed with SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE on every attempt.
